items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: I heard Bird when he was with Jay McShann... I caught the band and I heard it.

ctx.x: But you had heard what they were calling 'new music' in the service.

Only at the end of my -- it was just before my discharge that I started hearing it, because we didn't hear it overseas. Not in Okinawa, anyway. I had heard a victory broadcast one night, but it wasn't reached over there. I didn't hear it until I got back to the States, and I just happened to hear a record. Of course, I heard Bird when he was with Jay McShann; he come through Chicago; I was on my way to Wisconsin, and I think they played, Jimmy McShann (Drum Boogie) Shannon's band played -- was it "Geron-Bogie" at…
I knew it was a new sound - a new sound, but nobody called it bebop.
